question: Who banned the tractor stunt in Punjab in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhagwant Mann**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bhagwant Mann** banned the tractor stunt in Punjab in 2023.
 
• Bhagwant Mann is the **Chief Minister of Punjab**, representing the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP).
 
• The ban was implemented to ensure **public safety** and prevent accidents during tractor stunts.
 
• The decision was part of a broader initiative to **enhance road safety** and reduce incidents of reckless driving in the state.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bhagwant Mann took office as the Chief Minister of Punjab on **16th March 2022**.
 
• He is known for his efforts in addressing issues related to **corruption, education, and healthcare** in the state.
 
• Before entering politics, Bhagwant Mann was a well-known **comedian and satirist** in India.
 
• The ban on tractor stunts is part of a series of measures aimed at **improving public safety** and **reducing road accidents** in Punjab.
